youtube_description:
In this video I share some more news about the live-action remake of Moana.  Auli'l Cravalho will not reprise the role as Moana and Disney is currently holding an open casting call for the role.  It has also been announced that Thomas Kail (Hamilton) will direct the film and it will be released on June 27th 2025.  Watch this video for more details!
